description: Modify a Gmail thread: add/remove labels. To archive, remove INBOX. To mark read, remove UNREAD. To star, add STARRED.

addLabelIds.description: JSON array of label IDs to add, e.g. ["STARRED"]

removeLabelIds.description: JSON array of label IDs to remove, e.g. ["INBOX","UNREAD"]

name: gmail_threads_modify
